summary: AuthHeader() must not mutate AuthSource; Load() is the sole writer so auth status and doctor report the true credential origin.
reason: The generated AuthHeader() wrote AuthSource = 'env:SENDFOX_TOKEN' whenever SendfoxToken != '', overwriting the 'config' label set by Load() for file-persisted tokens. After the first call, auth status always reported env-var as the source even for saved tokens.
